mechanism: Isoniazid may cause hepatotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances; torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias and may worsen isoniazid-related peripheral neuropathy.
action: Monitor serum potassium, magnesium, and liver function tests regularly; consider potassium-sparing agent or supplementation; assess for signs of hepatotoxicity and neuropathy.
